notes: Every sensitive category appears and stays scoped to this one design project. IP assignment (3.1) covers only the paid final Deliverables, and Designer keeps pre-existing tools, drafts and unused concepts (3.2). Termination (5.2, 5.3) is mutual, needs 14 days' notice and pays for work done. Disputes (8.1, 8.2) cover only disputes arising under this Agreement and go to local courts. There is no non-compete; 6.1 leaves Designer free to take other clients. There is no auto-renewal (5.5). Indemnity (7.3) is mutual and limited to each party's own breach, and liability (7.4) is mutual and capped at the fee. A correct analysis returns zero flags.
